name: Turtleson
founders: Greg Oakley and Chet Sikorski (co-founders; previously co-founded what became Peter Millar, per Oakley)
why_quiet: Heathered, muted palette (navy heather, espresso, shadow grey, taupe) and fabric-first pieces — 100% pure cashmere, 100% extra-fine merino in fine-gauge knits, cotton/lyocell sateen trousers — with only a tiny woven turtle tab or tonal chest mark. Sold mainly through golf/resort pro shops; the brand says it blurs the line between performance and luxury.

quote.text: While some brands chase trends or margins, we remain focused on delivering consistent quality through carefully selected materials and timeless design.
quote.who: Greg Oakley, co-founder and CEO, Turtleson

facts.fact: Founded by Greg Oakley and Chet Sikorski in 2011 (company boilerplate in press release).
Started in East Tennessee with decades of sportswear experience; brand line 'Built on Better.'
Based in the founders' hometown of Bristol, Tennessee; Oakley and Sikorski earlier formed the company that became Peter Millar.
Sales mix per Oakley: ~70% golf/resort, 15% specialty retail, 15% e-commerce.
Officially licensed 2025 Ryder Cup apparel line.
US store prices in USD (Shopify currency active USD on turtleson.com).
Where garments are cut and sewn: UNVERIFIED (not stated on pages checked).
No dedicated 'golf' collection on the store — the whole menswear line is golf-oriented (polos, quarter-zips, merino/cashmere, golf-course campaign imagery).
